tool.name: ParaFEM to VTU (Steady State)
tool.description: Convert steady-state ParaFEM output to VTK Unstructured Grid (.vtu) for ParaView
tool.command:
mkdir -p run && cd run && cp '$d_file' job.d &&
#if str($bnd_file) != "None" cp '$bnd_file' job.bnd && #end if
#if str($fix_file) != "None" cp '$fix_file' job.fix && #end if
#if str($ensi_tarball) != "None" tar xzf '$ensi_tarball' && #end if
python3 '$__tool_directory__/parafem2vtu.py' --mesh_d job.d #if str($bnd_file) != "None" --bnd job.bnd #end if #if str($fix_file) != "None" --fix job.fix #end if #if str($ensi_tarball) != "None" --ensi_dir . #end if --jobname job --output result.vtu 2>&1 &&
cp result.vtu '$output_vtu'

param.name: d_file
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d mesh file with nodal coordinates and element connectivity

param.name: bnd_file
param.label: Boundary restraints (.bnd)
param.help: ParaFEM .bnd file — adds BoundaryNodes field to output

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: ParaFEM .fix file — adds FixedFreedoms field to output

param.name: ensi_tarball
param.label: Solver EnSight output (.tar.gz)
param.help: Tarball of .ensi.NDPTL-* or .ensi.DISPL-* files from solver

tool.help:
Converts steady-state ParaFEM mesh and solver output into a single VTK Unstructured Grid (.vtu) file for direct visualization in ParaView.
Output fields: - BoundaryNodes (from .bnd, if provided) - FixedFreedoms (from .fix, if provided) - MaterialID (if multiple materials) - Potential (NDPTL, from p123) - Displacement (DISPL, from p121/p122)
Supported element types: 8-node hex, 20-node hex, 4-node tet, 10-node tet.
This tool can be used at any pipeline stage: - After mesh generation: visualize mesh + boundary nodes - After BC generation: visualize mesh + fixed freedoms - After solver: visualize mesh + solution fields
